evals.prompt: Invoke the implement skill before answering. Resume a cross-platform file-watcher feature whose first implementation passed on macOS but failed on Linux because it relied on an OS-specific event API. Describe the recovery workflow.

Reproduces the Linux failure before editing
Names the failed OS-specific assumption
Adds a cross-platform test or measurable acceptance check
Avoids sequential or same-file parallel delegation
Does not claim readiness before supported-platform validation

evals.prompt: Invoke the implement skill before answering. Only repository read, edit, shell, and test tools are available. Implement a medium-sized feature from a local specification and explain how the workflow behaves without auxiliary skills or specialist agents.

assertions: Does not stop solely because general reasoning helpers are unavailable
Does not claim to invoke unavailable skills or agents
Uses repository guidance and direct tools

evals.prompt: Invoke the implement skill before answering. A durable job-processing API could use either the repository's relational database with leasing or a new queue service. Both are credible. Describe the design-decision workflow without claiming a design was selected.
